body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The fleet model plane and sandbox test suites (model-plane-read.test.mjs, model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs, synthetic-home-bwrap.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync and manage fixture cleanups via manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/fleet/test/model-plane-read.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update scratch(t, prefix) helper to accept t and return realpathSync(tmp(t, prefix)).
   - Update test declarations creating scratch fixtures to accept t and pass t to scratch(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync(root, ...), unindenting test bodies.
2. In packages/fleet/test/model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update scratch(t, prefix) helper to accept t and return realpathSync(tmp(t, prefix)).
   - Update test declarations creating scratch fixtures to accept t and pass t to scratch(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync(root, ...), unindenting test bodies.
3. In packages/fleet/test/synthetic-home-bwrap.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update scratch(t, prefix) helper to accept t and return realpathSync(tmp(t, prefix)).
   - Update test declarations creating scratch fixtures to accept t and pass t to scratch(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync(root, ...), unindenting test bodies.
4. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove 'packages/fleet/test/model-plane-read.test.mjs', 'packages/fleet/test/model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs', and 'packages/fleet/test/synthetic-home-bwrap.test.mjs' from the ALLOWLIST set.
5. Verification:
   - node --test packages/fleet/test/model-plane-read.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/synthetic-home-bwrap.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' packages/fleet/test/model-plane-read.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/synthetic-home-bwrap.test.mjs outputs 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/fleet/test/model-plane-read.test.mjs, model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs, and synthetic-home-bwrap.test.mjs contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 3 test files.
- AC3 None of the 3 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 node --test packages/fleet/test/model-plane-read.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/synthetic-home-bwrap.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(fleet): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in sandbox and model plane tests
